title: Kyno gives running agent workflows versioned human direction
friendlyTitle: Kyno helps agents follow your latest goals
summary: Kyno 1.0 provides a versioned store for an organization’s mission and operating principles, which agents retrieve through MCP at workflow step boundaries. Operators can update direction while a workflow continues and later inspect which version guided each step.
friendlySummary: Kyno stores your mission and rules in versions. Agents check for the newest version before their next step, and you can see which rules they used.
whyItMatters: Long-running agents can keep following yesterday’s priorities after the business changes course. Versioned direction offers a concrete way to update policy without restarting everything and to reconstruct why an agent made a decision.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can stop a long-running agent from following an old goal. It also makes the agent’s decisions easier to review.
